scope: 47 prospectively declared unscored native diagnostic attempts

configurationDifference.interpretation: positive documentation of the existing two-line return format
configurationDifference.originalDescription: Read the owned UTF-8 fixture file once and return its entire plain-text contents unchanged. The result is text, not a record of extracted field values; labels and separators are part of the file content.
configurationDifference.candidateDescription: Read the owned UTF-8 fixture file once and return its complete two-line plain-text contents unchanged. The returned text includes the `value:` and `receipt:` field-name prefixes, their following values, and the newline between the lines.

configurationDifference.mixedHistory: escaped preceding history followed by the current user content verbatim

configurationDifference.nonemptyUserOnlyMessages: join unchanged content with two newline characters
